reader_summary.headline: Allison Thacker is the President and Chief Investment Officer of Rice Management Company.
reader_summary.overview: Allison Thacker is the President and Chief Investment Officer of Rice Management Company, where she oversees Rice University's $8 billion dollar endowment. Allison spent eleven years picking growth stocks before joining Rice eleven years ago. Our conversation shares Allison's keen insights from experience as both a direct investor and endowment manager.
